title: Death Link
description: Play Together or Die Together - when one player dies, everyone dies.
body:
# Death Link

## Play Together or Die Together.

Death Link connects the fate of every player on the server. When one player dies, all players die instantly.

Whether you're attempting a hardcore challenge, playing with friends, or creating chaotic multiplayer events, Death Link adds a whole new level of teamwork and tension. Every risky decision matters because your mistakes affect everyone.

### Features

* Synchronizes player deaths across all linked players.
* Perfect for multiplayer challenge runs.
* Encourages teamwork and careful planning.
* Lightweight and simple to use.
* Great for Hardcore, Survival, and custom challenge worlds.

### How It Works

1. Players join the world or server.
2. Death Link automatically links participating players.
3. If a player dies, all other linked players die as well.
4. Survive together, or face the consequences together.

### Challenge Ideas

* Hardcore Death Link Survival
* Speedrunning with Death Link
* Randomized World Challenges
* Team Adventure Maps
* PvE Boss Rushes

No second chances. No carrying the team.

One life. One fate. One Death Link.
